## What is agentic demo software?

Agentic demo software uses AI agents to create, personalize, or deliver interactive product demonstrations. Unlike prerecorded videos or fixed click-through tours, an agentic demo can respond to buyer questions, understand their goals, and adapt the content or demo path without requiring a Solutions Engineer to guide every session. Supademo is an agentic demo platform that combines AI-assisted demo creation with an autonomous, buyer-facing AI Demo Agent. Teams can create, manage, personalize, and reuse interactive product content, then use the agent to deliver relevant demos and supporting resources to buyers.

The AI Demo Agent engages buyers through voice or text, asks questions to understand their needs, and surfaces relevant demos, documentation, videos, pricing information, and customer stories. It can capture buyer intent, summarize each conversation, and guide qualified prospects toward the next step, such as booking a meeting, starting a trial, or speaking with a sales representative.
